aeolia-belize-6.15.reason: no 6.15 Baikal kernel is known to work: the community Baikal kernel is 5.4.247-baikal-dfaus, the 5.15.15 Baikal port is reported non-functional, and the 7.0.8 Baikal binary (X-F1REBALL-X) has no pinned source. The 6.15.4 base tree only carries Baikal PCI IDs in apcie/ahci/sky2, not the Baikal patch set. The GE needs 6.15 interfaces (TTM shrink helpers, dmem cgroup).
